subject: Mobile Development
title: iPhone OS: The Beginning
description: A short lesson to help you apply iPhone OS: The Beginning.

hook.text: In 2007, the first iPhone ran 'iPhone OS' — a stripped-down version of Mac OS X.

buildup.text: Apple adapted its desktop Unix-based system for a device with no keyboard and limited RAM.

discovery.text: The first iPhone OS had no App Store, no copy-paste, and no multitasking.

twist.text: Steve Jobs initially wanted only web apps. Engineers secretly prototyped native app support.

climax.text: That secret prototype became the SDK that launched the app revolution in 2008.

punchline.text: The app revolution started as a secret project.
